case.summary: The investigation for CASE-010 was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.8 on transaction 4012174 ($400.32, domestic) [EV-46d16544]. The card SC-03010-K950 showed four prior transactions averaging $295.99 [EV-29b6b71c] and four online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-a84f349b]. The transaction originated from a new device profile (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) [EV-99e0872f] and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-f17de674]. The customer reported they did not make the purchases and still possessed the card [EV-36fd7b3d]. Prior fraud history includes one confirmed case for this customer/card (CC-4321) [EV-a155f1d6] and the same device profile appearing in another confirmed fraud case [EV-2dc38abc]. Six similar prior cases matching the card_not_present_new_device pattern were also identified [EV-9adc6261]. The case was closed with a fraud verdict and exposure of $1,183.95 across four transactions.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report covers CASE-010, a confirmed card-not-present fraud involving card SC-03010-K950 with total exposure of $1,183.95 across four transactions (4012174, 4012175, 4012176, 4012177). The fraud was detected via real-time risk scoring (0.8) on transaction 4012174 [EV-46d16544]. Analysis revealed the transactions originated from a previously unseen device profile (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) [EV-99e0872f] and an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina [EV-f17de674], both indicative of account takeover. The customer confirmed they did not authorize the purchases and retained physical possession of the card [EV-36fd7b3d]. The card's recent history showed four online transactions within 48 hours [EV-a84f349b], deviating from the average transaction amount of $295.99 [EV-29b6b71c]. The device profile has been linked to a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-2dc38abc], and the customer has a previous fraud case (CC-4321) [EV-a155f1d6]. Six additional prior cases sharing the card_not_present_new_device pattern were identified [EV-9adc6261], suggesting a recurring modus operandi. The bank's policy engine returned a fraud verdict with probability 0.868. Funds recovery and card reissuance procedures have been initiated per standard protocol.
